name: Wine Country Run (Temecula Half Marathon, 10K, 5K & Kids Run)
blurb: Half marathon, 10K, 5K, and kids run through Temecula wine country, start and finish at Wilson Creek. Confirm times and registration on the official race site.

name: De Portola Wine Trail Harvest Celebration
blurb: A trail-wide harvest day among De Portola tasting rooms (small bites and wine). Same date as the Wine Country Run, so check traffic and parking if you are doing both.

name: Peltzer Pumpkin Farm & Harvest Festival
blurb: Seasonal pumpkin farm and harvest activities. Hours and tickets change; confirm on the farm site before you drive.

name: Temecula Chilled
blurb: Old Town winter program (ice and holiday programming). Dates and hours are posted by Visit Temecula Valley each season.

name: Holiday Taste of Old Town
blurb: Holiday tasting walk in Old Town. Confirm tickets and participating restaurants with Old Town Temecula.

name: Santa's Electric Light Parade
blurb: Evening holiday parade. Street closures affect Old Town access; check the city or Old Town listing the week of the event.
